# Security Policy — SCAMSCAN PRO

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security issue in SCAMSCAN PRO, please report
it privately:

Email: chitralcybersquad@gmail.com
Subject: [SECURITY] SCAMSCAN PRO — brief description

Do NOT open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.

---

## Scope

In-scope:
- The scamscan.sh script
- Configuration handling
- Report generation
- Any code in this repository

Out-of-scope:
- Third-party APIs used by the tool
- The user's Termux environment
- Target websites being scanned

---

## Response Timeline

- Acknowledgment: within 48 hours
- Initial assessment: within 7 days
- Fix or mitigation: within 30 days

---

## Ethical Use Enforcement

Reports of misuse by third parties will be:
- Documented
- Forwarded to law enforcement if warranted
- Used to strengthen the tool's legal safeguards
